criteria.evidence: KeywordCoverageCalculator is named coverage, never match/fit/ATS. Traced prototype JD by hand: 8 distinct display-lowercased keywords, now 5/8=63, upTo 6/8=75, final 63 / 75 with stakeholder bullet. Test prototypeJdAnsweredYesPlusDetailAssertsLiteralPercents asserts the literals and matches the PR body. percent is half-up integer math.
keywordOf lowercases displayName so case variants collapse; percent returns 0 for total 0. Tests repeatedKeywordsDifferingInCaseCountOnce and noKeywordsGivesZeroPercents.

Only YES_REGULARLY and A_FEW_TIMES count; blank detail confirms only isNamedSkillKeyword keywords (D38), tested by blankDetailAnswerWithoutNamedSkillConfirmsNothing and ...ConfirmsNamedSkillKeywords. Non-blank detail still lets requirement.text alone confirm keywords (see finding). Requirement ids and numbers never reach the count.
final reads ACCEPTED proposedText and originalText otherwise; tests finalCountsAcceptedTextOnly, rejectedChangeContributesOriginalText, pendingChangeContributesOriginalText each assert 25.
ScreenForKeywords partitions MET/PARTIAL vs rest, distinct by lowercase display name, missing excludes have. ScreenForKeywordsTest covers the prototype 5/3/8.
ProfileCompleteness = 100 - 4 (blank LinkedIn) - 6 per gap, floored at 0; test asserts 90/96/100, 40 gaps give 0, blank-space LinkedIn counts as absent.

RequiredGaps: EXPERIENCE with non-blank start and blank end. Any non-blank end (Present/Current included) is not a gap; D24 server maps unsupported Present to blank end so it is a gap. Tests cover fresh/returning fixtures, non-experience, closed, undated, whitespace end.

ObserveStartDestinationUseCase: no account -> SignIn; onboardingComplete or reviewedAt -> Applications; else Upload. AppViewModel maps Upload to FirstRun. ObserveStartDestinationUploadTest covers the five cases and would fail if the order changed.

Format skipped as Builder-written (Reviewer B). Implementation reads as Name_Company_Role with hyphen words, .pdf, 100 char cap; the prototype README and Prototype.dc.html are not in the checkout, so I could not verify FMTS or the one-page rule here. The one-page rule is not touched by this PR.
Not verified: delivery-gates-pregate was still IN_PROGRESS at review and no koverVerify result is attached. Test compilation depends on the lead-only patch noted in the PR body.
verify-local.sh result not available to me; CI check not complete at review time.

findings.rule: D38 / Constitution I.1: an answer must not turn requirement words into a confirmed keyword
findings.trigger: Gap requirement r5 'Python and SQL' (EXPERIENCE type), answer A_FEW_TIMES with detail 'n/a' (non-blank, names nothing). stated(requirement, requirement.text + newline + detail) finds python and sql in requirement.text itself, so upTo counts both although the user supplied no evidence. Only a fully blank detail is guarded.
findings.proof: KeywordCoverageCalculatorTest: matches [GAP requirement 'Python and SQL' keywords python, sql], QuickAnswer(id,'YES_REGULARLY','n/a') -> expect upTo == now, currently upTo is 100
findings.title: Non-blank vague detail confirms every keyword in the requirement text
